page.notes: The Greek in the last line is partly doubtful and has been copied from a small, worn print; the first word and the words after "ἐγνῷ" should be checked against the scan. "deiectus" is doubtful: the print may show a space after "de". Printed letters in long s, reversed-j and similar spellings (Pontificijs, Concilijs, adiuuare, reijciendi) have been normalised to u/v and i/j per the rules; the original spelling is noted here: "Pontificijs", "Concilijs", "reijciendi", "adiuuare".
